_comment: Tenant registry for the archive site. Each collection published here is a tenant with its own URL prefix, data file, asset base and watermark. The owner is tenant zero: an empty urlPrefix keeps its page/asset URLs exactly as they were. See vinyl-site-multitenancy-design.md. Client (private) tenants are served via Cloudflare Access + a private R2 bucket in Phase P; the per-tenant nav / {{ROOT}} depth and multi-tenant loop are Phase B B3+.
